overview: A vast UNESCO site of 14th–16th century Vijayanagara ruins among giant boulders and banana fields on the Tungabhadra river. It feels like an open-air adventure playground with history at every turn.
fit: Great for the 10-year-old who likes history and climbing. Hot and spread out, so plan short sessions for the 4-year-old.
season: November to February is best (15–30°C). March–May is very hot (38°C+). Monsoon is mild here; August–September is green with light rain.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Hubballi or Bengaluru, then drive (Vijayanagar/Toranagallu airport JSW also has some flights)
Chennai to Hosapete (via Bengaluru or Guntakal), 13 km from Hampi

gettingAround: Hire a car with driver or an auto for the day. Battery buggies run between the main temples.
